.. NEXUS documentation master file

NEXUS AI Trading System
=======================

**An intelligent algorithmic trading platform built with understanding as the core principle.**

NEXUS is designed for clarity and safety. Every component serves a clear, comprehensible purpose with comprehensive validation and risk controls.
